pages.text_excerpt: MSF Staff Rewards | MSF Skip to main content MSF Staff Rewards Community health workers in Bentiu internally displaced persons camp, discussing the hepatitis E vaccination campaign. © Peter Caton Share Introduction MSF as an employer provides its staff with remuneration packages that include salaries and benefits. The benefits and salary a staff member receives depend on their position, where they work and how they are contracted. MSF’s staff rewards are defined based on global frameworks and grids applicable to different categories of staff and on local labour markets, laws, regulations and practices. They are also based on a set of principles agreed at the international level, which include statements on HR principles, MSF as a Responsible Employer and Behaviour.
